title: Wheeler Real Estate Investment Trust, Inc. 8-K Filing — 2026-04-13
summary: Wheeler Real Estate Investment Trust, Inc. filed a Form 8-K announcing a one-for-three reverse stock split of its common stock, effective April 17, 2026. The reverse split reduces outstanding shares from 1,813,124 to approximately 604,374. Trading on a split-adjusted basis begins April 20, 2026 under a new CUSIP number (963025762). Conversion rates for convertible notes and preferred stock are proportionally adjusted.
key_points: One-for-three reverse stock split effective 5:00 PM ET on April 17, 2026
Trading on split-adjusted basis begins April 20, 2026 (market open)
New CUSIP number: 963025762; trading symbol unchanged (WHLR)
Convertible notes (7.00% due 2031): conversion rate reduced from ~43.85 to ~14.62 shares per $25 principal
Fractional shares paid out in cash based on April 17 closing price
Par value decreased from $0.03 to $0.01 per share post-split
why_it_matters: This is a routine corporate action for a small-cap REIT (Wheeler Real Estate Investment Trust) that does not impact broader markets. The reverse stock split is a common compliance measure to maintain Nasdaq listing requirements or improve per-share price. It has no relevance to macro catalysts or systemic market structure.
